$description:
Segment contract — the SELECTABLE / GROUPED action-control archetype.

Covers the controls that present a SET of options where a resting cell flips to
a SELECTED cell: Toggle, ToggleGroup, SegmentedControl, Tabs, and other option
/ group-action rows. These are NOT single call-to-action buttons (that is the
`control` archetype) — so they get their OWN namespace and never borrow the
Button's control chrome. This is the token home for "secondary action controls."

── TWO authored tonal styles for the SELECTED cell ────────────────────────
  1. neutral (default) — a quiet neutral fill (the segmented-control default).
  2. primary           — the brand-accent fill (radio-like emphasis / a
                         highlighted current selection).
  The recipe picks one via a tone flag, e.g. [data-tone='primary'].
  The RESTING + HOVER treatment is shared by both tones — only the selected
  cell differs between neutral and primary.

── AXIS TRAP (learned on Input/Switch — see selection.css) ────────────────
  Tokens whose value references mode/theme/brand semantics — every COLOUR here
  (the fills + foregrounds, e.g. --a63-action-neutral is mode-split light/dark,
  --a63-action-primary follows the brand axis) — must NOT be declared at :root.
  A var(--a63-action-*) resolved at :root freezes to the root's mode/theme and
  inherits that frozen value into .dark / [data-a63-theme] subtrees.
  So: the COLOUR hooks are consumed at the recipe USE-SITE with the live-semantic
  fallback shown in the API block below, and a THEME overrides them under its
  own [data-a63-theme='…'] scope (never :root). Only axis-INDEPENDENT geometry
  + treatment defaults are declared at :root here.

RADIUS is read at the recipe USE-SITE, NOT declared here. It's multiplier-
dependent (--radius-md/-sm), so a :root declaration would freeze to the root
multiplier and ignore the radius axis (the same trap fixed in menu.css):
  bar / outer cell -> var(--a63-segment-radius, var(--radius-md))
  inset selected   -> var(--a63-segment-selected-radius, var(--radius-sm))
Grouped/segmented controls stay TIGHTER than a standalone control pill (they
do NOT read --a63-control-radius, which a theme can inflate to a pill).

TREATMENT (track/selected gloss + shadow) is likewise read at the use-site,
bridging to the control archetype until a theme/Figma sets a segment value:
  track    -> var(--a63-segment-track-gloss,    var(--a63-control-gloss))
              var(--a63-segment-track-shadow,   var(--a63-control-shadow))
  selected -> var(--a63-segment-selected-gloss, var(--a63-control-gloss))
              var(--a63-segment-selected-shadow,var(--a63-control-shadow))
A theme/Figma overrides any of these under [data-a63-theme='…'] to give
segments their OWN character instead of borrowing the button's.

gap.$description: welded by default; a gapped variant overrides
